title: bashy live — Chrome Web Store fields
intro: Paste each value into the matching field of the developer dashboard. Upload the zip from `bashy dag chrome-ext-release` and the screenshots in docs/chrome-web-store/.

fields.label: Description
fields.value:
bashy live is the companion that lets bashy, the agentic shell on your computer, work on web pages in your real, signed-in browser.

Fill in forms: tell bashy what to enter and it fills the fields for you, on the sites where you are already signed in. Before it types into a password, payment or other secret field, it asks you first.

It can also read a page's text, click, scroll, take screenshots and, when you ask, read a site's cookies after you sign in.

How it works: run "bashy browser hub", then press Connect in this extension's popup on the tab you want bashy to work on. The extension talks only to bashy on your machine (127.0.0.1). It contacts no other server, has no analytics and runs no remote code. Typed and clipboard values are logged by length only.

Open source (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/qiangli/yoke

fields.label: Single purpose
fields.value: A companion for bashy: lets the bashy program on the user's own computer work on web pages in the user's browser (fill in forms, read page content, click, take screenshots) over a local 127.0.0.1 connection, at the user's request.

fields.label: tabs
fields.value: List, open, switch and address the tabs bashy is asked to drive.

fields.label: activeTab
fields.value: Act on the tab the user connects from the popup.

fields.label: scripting
fields.value: Inject the extension's own bundled page script to read text and fill, click or scroll elements.

fields.label: Host permission (<all_urls>)
fields.value: bashy live lets the bashy program on the user's own computer complete multi-step tasks on websites the user chooses at run time, such as filling a form across several pages. activeTab is insufficient: its grant ends when the tab navigates, and every task navigates (form steps, sign-in redirects, confirmation pages), so access would be lost after the first step. A fixed site list is not possible: the user decides which sites bashy works on, and those are unknown when the extension is published. The extension acts only after the user presses Connect in its popup, only on the tabs bashy is asked to drive, and it talks only to bashy on 127.0.0.1. It sends nothing to any server and runs no remote code.

fields.label: debugger
fields.value: Send trusted keystrokes and text input that sites accept only from a real user; capture screenshots of a background tab and full-page screenshots without stealing focus; read the driven tab's network requests, console messages and performance trace when the user asks bashy to debug that page. Attached only to tabs bashy is driving, only while the user has connected the extension.

fields.label: cookies
fields.value: Read a site's cookies, including HttpOnly ones, when the user asks bashy to complete a login and capture its session.

fields.label: clipboardRead
fields.value: Paste actions the user requests through bashy.

fields.label: clipboardWrite
fields.value: Copy actions the user requests through bashy.

fields.label: storage
fields.value: Remember the user's Connect choice, port and tab.

fields.label: alarms
fields.value: Keep the local connection alive and reconnect after the browser suspends the service worker.

fields.label: Remote code
fields.value: No, I am not using remote code. All JavaScript ships in the package.
